title: Calling a lambda immediately
description: You can follow an inner function used directly in operator position.

steps.description: plusminus names an outer function with parameters a and b. You supply both values when calling it.
The inner lambda accepts x and y and builds a list containing their sum and difference. The surrounding call passes a and b into that lambda immediately.

steps.question: Which two values appear in the result of (plusminus 6 2)?
steps.answer: The sum is 8 and the difference is 4, so the result is (8 4).

steps.description: You see (8 4) in the output. The inner function expression serves as the operator for the call on lines 3 and 4.
